whyItMatters: Detects Cognito identity-pool credential issuance (GetCredentialsForIdentity / GetOpenIdToken) used to obtain AWS credentials from an identity pool, including unauthenticated pools.

threatContext.attackerBehavior: Detects Cognito identity-pool credential issuance (GetCredentialsForIdentity / GetOpenIdToken) used to obtain AWS credentials from an identity pool, including unauthenticated pools.
threatContext.whyItMatters: Cognito Identity Pool Credentials Retrieved is a high-signal control-plane action with no prior Sigma coverage in this catalog.
threatContext.riskAndImpact: If missed, the technique node stays dark and the attacker action is invisible.

limitations: Management events only; data-plane follow-on is out of scope for this rule.

enrichment.description: Compare the caller to identity and platform-admin inventories.
enrichment.falsePositiveReduction: Suppress known IdP or CI roles after review.

logicExplanation.humanReadable: Fire on successful GetCredentialsForIdentity from cognito-identity.amazonaws.com.
logicExplanation.whenToFire: On each matching successful CloudTrail event.
